title: Will this be Jonathan Taylor's last game with the Colts?; The trade deadline looms
text: The Athletic's James Boyd and 107.5 The Fan's Caleb Zuver discuss whether Sunday's matchup against the Dallas Cowboys could be Jonathan Taylor's last game with the Indianapolis Colts. title: Is Jonah Coleman the Broncos' new CLOSER? Plus, Bryant's return in Week 9? | Orange & Blue Today

title: The ghost of Jeff Stoutland, and how it haunts the Eagles | unCovering the Birds with Jeff McLane
channel_name: unCovering the Birds with Jeff McLane
text: With the Eagles’ season gradually going up in flames, there’s been plenty of external finger pointing. The offense, specifically the line, has drawn considerable ire, especially in light of the Eagles parting ways with longtime, beloved assistant coach Jeff Stoutland. Stoutland’s track record on the offensive line is Hall of Fame-worthy. This year, with Chris Kuper as Stoutland’s replacement, the line has regressed. Should Kuper shoulder most of the blame? What really happened between Stoutland and the Eagles that caused their relationship to fall apart? The Philadelphia Inquirer’s Jeff McLane dives deeper into one of the biggest “what ifs” from a frustrating season, framing Stoutland’s exit around four key questions. 03:04 Question 1: Why did Jeff Stoutland and the Eagles part ways? 08:18 Question 2: Did any of the Eagles’ offensive linemen want Stoutland’s role to change? 15:20 Question 3: How did the Stoutland - Eagles divorce happen? 18:52 Question 4: If Stoutland were still on the coaching staff, would it make a difference this year? unCovering the Birds is a production of The Philadelphia Inquirer and KYW Newsradio Original Podcasts. Look for new episodes throughout the season. We want mailbag questions! Hit Jeff up on his socials, or drop a question in the comments. Jeff could answer it in a future episode! You can also watch unCovering the Birds on the KYW Newsradio and Philadelphia Inquirer YouTube channels.
